profile.headline: Lead Software Engineer @ Analytic Partners
profile.summary:
Software Engineer Frontend with a passion for creating beautiful, responsive and user-centric applications. I strive to build future proof applications by writing clean, scalable and maintainable code. Always enthusiastic to learn, experiment with and implement new technologies that can help in the success of the team and company.

Experience with: HTML5, CSS3, SASS, Less, Styled Components, JavaScript(ES6+), React, React Native, Redux, Redux-Saga, Express.js, GraphQL, GIT, Unit Testing (Jest, React Testing Library)

positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States

positions.title: Student Software Engineer
positions.description: Immersive Software Development bootcamp with a concentration on Ruby, Ruby on Rails, JavaScript and React. The in-person bootcamp lasts approximately 15 weeks.

positions.title: Tax Preparer
positions.description: Prepared taxes for individuals and small family owned corporations. Provided advice to customers on how they can increase their tax refund or decrease their tax liability within the rules and regulations set by the irs.
